expectations.name: 01-acts-on-the-reason
expectations.text:
The reply gives the steps that bring receipts back: check and start the larder-worker service, and confirm through
the waiting jobs in procrastinate_jobs that the receipts go out.
expectations.evidence: The reply does not instruct checking or starting larder-worker, counting procrastinate_jobs grouped by status, or watching the todo count fall to 0 to confirm receipts go out. Instead, it says the issue 'needs a code fix and redeploy.'

expectations.name: 02-names-a-fact
expectations.text: The reply names both the larder-worker service and the procrastinate_jobs table.
